Asset Numbering Convention (Revised)

All asset IDs follow the pattern CT-<System>-<Serial>, where <System> is the two-letter or three-letter code for the equipment category (e.g., CH for chiller, AHU for air handling unit, PMP for pump, EF for exhaust fan, DG for diesel generator, UPS for uninterruptible power supply, VRF for variable refrigerant flow outdoor unit, LFT for lift motor, SDP for sewage drainage pump). The serial number is assigned sequentially per system, starting from 01. For AHUs, the serial number also embeds the floor level: CT-AHU-01 to CT-AHU-43, where the mapping to levels is fixed as per the original installation schedule (Level 1 to Level 15). This mapping is maintained in the master list and should not be inferred from the serial number alone.

For pumps, the serial number is CT-PMP-01 to CT-PMP-18 for the duty pumps and CT-PMP-S1 and CT-PMP-S2 for the two standby units. The 'S' prefix distinguishes standby units from duty units. All new additions after the initial register compilation will follow the same pattern, with the next available serial number in the relevant system. If a unit is decommissioned, its serial number is retired and not re-used.

Site-wise Summary

The register covers a single site, Crystal Tower, located at Plot No. 17, Sector 44, Gurugram, Haryana. All asset IDs carry the 'CT' prefix, which is the site code for Crystal Tower. No other sites are included in this register. The building has a basement, ground floor, and 15 upper floors. The total floor area is approximately 28,500 square metres. The register was first compiled in March 2016 and has been updated on an ongoing basis since then. The last full review was completed on 15 December 2024 by the facility management team.

Section-wise Notes

Section A – Chillers: 4 chillers with a combined capacity of 1,410 kW. This includes 2 water-cooled centrifugal chillers (450 kW each) and 2 air-cooled screw chillers (255 kW each). The air-cooled chillers are used for low-load periods and as backup during monsoon. All chillers are operational as of the last review.

Section B – Cooling Towers: 3 induced-draft cooling towers, each rated at 25 kW fan motor power, giving a total of 75 kW. These serve the water-cooled chillers. One tower is normally kept on standby depending on the chiller running configuration.

Section C – AHUs: 43 units covering Level 1 to Level 15, with two AHUs per floor (south wing and north wing) for Levels 1 to 14, and one AHU for Level 15 (south wing only). The north wing of Level 15 is served by the VRF system listed under Section H. Total AHU capacity is 850 kW, which is the sum of the individual unit ratings (22 kW for south wing units and 18 kW for north wing units, with the Level 1 units being 18 kW each on both wings).

Section D – Pumps: 18 duty pumps plus 2 standby pumps, total duty capacity 412.5 kW. This section includes:

Asset Numbering Convention (Revised)

All asset IDs follow the pattern CT-<System>-<Serial>, where <System> is the two-letter or three-letter code for the equipment category (e.g., CH for chiller, AHU for air handling unit, PMP for pump, EF for exhaust fan, DG for diesel generator, UPS for uninterruptible power supply, VRF for variable refrigerant flow outdoor unit, LFT for lift motor, SDP for sewage drainage pump). The serial number is assigned sequentially per system, starting from 01. For AHUs, the serial number also embeds the floor level: CT-AHU-01 to CT-AHU-43, where the mapping to levels is fixed as per the original installation schedule (Level 1 to Level 15). This mapping is maintained in the master list and should not be inferred from the serial number alone.

For pumps, the serial number is CT-PMP-01 to CT-PMP-18 for the duty pumps and CT-PMP-S1 and CT-PMP-S2 for the two standby units. The 'S' prefix distinguishes standby units from duty units. All new additions after the initial register compilation will follow the same pattern, with the next available serial number in the relevant system. If a unit is decommissioned, its serial number is retired and not re-used.

Site-wise Summary

The register covers a single site, Crystal Tower, located at Plot No. 17, Sector 44, Gurugram, Haryana. All asset IDs carry the 'CT' prefix, which is the site code for Crystal Tower. No other sites are included in this register. The building has a basement, ground floor, and 15 upper floors. The total floor area is approximately 28,500 square metres. The register was first compiled in March 2016 and has been updated on an ongoing basis since then. The last full review was completed on 15 December 2024 by the facility management team.

Section-wise Notes

Section A – Chillers: 4 chillers with a combined capacity of 1,410 kW. This includes 2 water-cooled centrifugal chillers (450 kW each) and 2 air-cooled screw chillers (255 kW each). The air-cooled chillers are used for low-load periods and as backup during monsoon. All chillers are operational as of the last review.

Section B – Cooling Towers: 3 induced-draft cooling towers, each rated at 25 kW fan motor power, giving a total of 75 kW. These serve the water-cooled chillers. One tower is normally kept on standby depending on the chiller running configuration.

Section C – AHUs: 43 units covering Level 1 to Level 15, with two AHUs per floor (south wing and north wing) for Levels 1 to 14, and one AHU for Level 15 (south wing only). The north wing of Level 15 is served by the VRF system listed under Section H. Total AHU capacity is 850 kW, which is the sum of the individual unit ratings (22 kW for south wing units and 18 kW for north wing units, with the Level 1 units being 18 kW each on both wings).

Section D – Pumps: 18 duty pumps plus 2 standby pumps, total duty capacity 412.5 kW. This section includes:
